subject.title: [Bug] Dreaming narrative: hardcoded 60s timeout includes lane-queue wait; timeout disposal aborts the primary call then discards the successful fallback-model output

question: What memory-core Dream Diary timeout and timeout-cleanup contract should this issue use before a repair PR proceeds?
rationale: The source bug is credible, but exposing `dreaming.execution.*` or changing fallback cleanup semantics is a public plugin config and compatibility decision that overlaps existing timeout-only and Dream Diary control work.

options.title: Broader Narrative Contract
options.body: Define one accepted contract covering timeout config, queue-versus-execution deadline semantics, and late-output cleanup/readback, then implement it across schema, runtime, docs, and tests.

options.title: Timeout-Only First
options.body: Refresh and review PR #78440 for configurable timeout support, while keeping queue-time accounting and timeout cleanup as explicit follow-up work.

options.title: No New Config Surface
options.body: Fix queue-time accounting and timeout cleanup internally while leaving the public Dream Diary configuration limited to the existing documented settings.

recommendation.title: Broader Narrative Contract
recommendation.body: Define one accepted contract covering timeout config, queue-versus-execution deadline semantics, and late-output cleanup/readback, then implement it across schema, runtime, docs, and tests.
